notes.title: Dragon Sprouts 1.0!, and what's next?
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Dragon Sprouts 1.0 is Here![/b]
After months of updates, feedback, and cozy dragon-raising, [i]Dragon Sprouts[/i] is officially out of Early Access![/h2][p][b]This 1.0 update includes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New buildable items to spruce up your sanctuary[/p][/*][*][p]Butterflies[/p][/*][*][p]Subtle changes to dragon behaviors (this sets up things for adding a little more variety to them later on)[/p][/*][*][p]A rewritten building system under the hood, making it a lot easier for me to add more content moving forward[/p][/*][*][p]Removed analytics that were used during early access and removed related settings and popups.[/p][/*][*][p]All the core features I originally set out to include when this journey began![/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much to everyone who supported the game during Early Access. Your feedback helped shape what [i]Dragon Sprouts[/i] is today—and what it will continue to become.[/p][h1]What's next? [/h1][p] I’ll be adding more buildables on a regular basis, and a brand-new UI framework is currently in the works to make the experience even smoother and more magical.[/p][p][/p][p]I burnt myself out a little bit, as putting this game out as a solo dev in just 3 months was a lot of work. To help recover, I'm going to spend the next few weeks working on a [b]fun fast paced physics platformer.[/b] My only rules for making the game are more speed, more things go boom, and to just make it fun. I think you'll find it's a lot of fun.[/p][p]You can Wishlist it now, and I'll have a demo out for it very soon. [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2882860/BaaBaa_Blitz_The_Sheeps_kebab_Incident"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]I also recently improved the framework I use to make games and will be working to put that into Dragon Sprouts over time. [/p][p]With the new setup for adding content, I'll be able to add content to Dragon Sprouts at regular intervals.[/p][p]Thanks again, have fun, and see you on the Discord.[/p]

notes.title: Delayed 1.0, locked out of submitting new builds.
notes.notes: [p]I had to reset the phone that had Steam on it, which also reset Steam Guard which caused a 72-hour lock out of setting any new builds live across all my organizations for 72 hours. I've opened a ticket with support, but that can take hours or days to get a response. So, it might be a bit before the update gets pushed.[/p]

notes.title: 🌟🎉 Dragon Sprouts is about to leave Early Access! 🐉💫
notes.notes:
[p]After months of cozy chaos, dragon-raising, and so many updates…[/p][p][b]🌟[/b]🎉 [i][b]Dragon Sprouts[/b][/i][b] is about to leave Early Access![/b] [b]  🐉💫[/b][/p][p] What started as a solo dev passion project (built in just 90 days!) has grown into a magical little world thanks to your support and feedback.[/p][p][b]When: Soon.[/b] I don't have an exact date, but it could be anytime now. I have just a few more things to finish up.[/p][p]I wanted to give a heads up that saves will break in this next release. There's a lot of changes and there was no way to preserve saves with this one. That's part of the reason there's been a bit of a delay between updates. With breaking things, I want to get as much in there as I can before the update. I won't be able to get everything I'd like to in, but I'm going to work every moment I can to get as much as possible done.[/p][p]There will still be more updates and content coming, but the game is far enough along that I don't think I should keep calling it early access. That means when this next update is released the game will also move out of early access.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🧡 What’s New in the Full Release?[/b][/p][list][*][p]14 dragons to discover & raise on a new map with new progression mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]A creative map that will have any dragons unlocked in the main game.[/p][/*][*][p]More decorations, polish, and bug squashing[/p][/*][*][p]Snacks for your dragons[/p][/*][*][p]UI improvements, performance boosts & surprises[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re here for the dragons, the building, or the peaceful vibes there’s more to explore than ever.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🌿 Thank You for Growing With Me[/b][/p][p]I can’t say this enough: this game wouldn’t exist without you.
From bug reports to fan art, feedback and kind messages the community made this happen. 🥲[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🎮 What Comes Next?[/b]
This isn’t the end, it’s just the beginning of the [i]next chapter[/i].
Seasonal updates, new biomes, dragons, features, and deeper dragon behaviors are all on the roadmap. I’m not going anywhere. 🛠️✨[/p][hr][/hr][p]🐲 Haven’t joined yet? Now’s the perfect time to start your sanctuary. [/p][p] [url="https://discord.gg/neB2JrcFFD" style="button"]Join us on Discord[/url][/p][p]Thanks for being here. Let’s keep building something magical. 💚
~ Morgan[/p]

notes.title: 🌟 Small Magic, Big Impact 🐉

notes.title: 🌱 A Little Thank You – New Demo Update & Creative Mode Improvements! 🐉
notes.notes:
[p][b]🌱 A Little Thank You – New Demo Update & Creative Mode! 🐉[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Last year, I was laid off from AAA. With the job market looking grim, I decided to take a leap of faith—and after just 90 days of development, [i]Dragon Sprouts[/i] launched into Early Access earlier this month.[/p][p]What’s blown me away is [i]you[/i]. The support, feedback, and kindness I’ve received has meant the world to me.[/p][p]I know it takes a special kind of trust to support a game this early in development, especially when so many early access projects never quite make it. I wanted to say thank you in the best way I can right now.[/p][p]✨ [b]So here’s what’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]The full Early Access test map is now available in the free demo.[/b]
Even if you’re just checking things out, you’ll get a better look at where the game’s heading.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A new Free Build / Creative Mode has been added to the full game![/b]
Craft your dream sanctuary without limits, just you and your dragons.[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s a small gesture, but I hope it shows how much your support means—and gives you a little something extra to enjoy while I keep building [i]Dragon Sprouts[/i] into the cozy magical world it’s meant to be.[/p][p]With all my heart—thank you.[/p][p]💖 – Morgan[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: 🌼 Hotfix Patch – Save & Quit Behavior Fixed 🐉 🐌⏸️ 💾💤

If you tried to [b]Save & Quit[/b] while the game was paused, the game would [i]refuse to actually quit[/i] until you unpaused it. 🐌⏸️[/p][p]That’s now been fixed! Save & Quit works smoothly whether the game is paused or not. Your sanctuary is safe, and you can exit with ease. 💾💤[/p]

notes.title: Daily Patch: Minor update. Some minor silliness hiding
notes.notes: [p]Just a few small updates today. I needed to take a small break so only worked half of my normal day. These notes included changes from the hotfix published earlier today. I'm going to try and reduce patches to no more than once a day from here on out.[/p][list][*][p]new animation added to project, not yet used in game[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unused nodes from Player Controller[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]reduce spawn rate of clutter[/p][/*][*][p]Regions now spawn clutter with a slight random variation so that in theory, they will each spawn at slightly different intervals. This is to reduce the amount happening in any given tick[/p][/*][*][p]Change clutter trace logic to count blocked tiles towards total tick spawn limit (i.e. if 4 could spawn and 3 traces return blocked, and one does not, only one clutter will spawn and traces will terminate) this reduces the overall rate that corruption spawns in a region as the number of player build areas increase and/or the number of clutter object present in the region increases. This also prevents tracing the entire region if no available cells are present.[/p][/*][*][p]Shrubbery. Ni.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Game Pausing and player remapping of its input.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Add volume control to soundtrack manager's blend new track and play track functions[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced volume of music played in opening cinematics in Early Access Map 01[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust default audio volumes, reduced music sound class default volume, increased voice sound class default volume[/p][/*][*][p]renamed grid snapping to object snapping which is more precise. There is no grid, but some objects snap to a given interval depending on the type of asset. Cleared tutorials are coming, and not all buildable items currently have snapping.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fix for eggs not spawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Spawners can receive the remainder of player's magic if total magic is less than amount of magic normally drained in a single tick.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🪄 Portals, Corruption, and... More Dragons?! 🐣

🪄[b] Portals, Corruption, and... More Dragons?![/b] 🐣

A wave of magic has swept through Dragon Sprouts! This new update introduces rifts in the veil between this world and the hidden realm where the dragons hid their last eggs. You'll use these mysterious gateways to bring dragons back into the world. With a little bit of magic you’ll help these eggs hatch and join your growing sanctuary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/415f0a7a979f910df019b414b104453d5a4c79b2.png[/img]

What’s New:

🌟 Use magic to open portals and summon new dragon eggs
🌱 Cleanse corruption to reclaim lost land
🐉 Hatch and raise even more adorable dragons
🏡 Keep building the cozy sanctuary of your dreams

The land is calling, the dragons are waiting—ready to bring the magic back?

notes.title: Hatching New Features: A Dragon Sprouts Progress Report!
notes.notes:
Exciting things are happening in Dragon Sprouts! This update brings a wave of improvements, making your dragon sanctuary even more fun, cozy, and customizable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/7c2aafc6e987e7134d2d6097ed2fc1b872f582e6.png[/img]
✨ New Features & Improvements:

🎮 Control Remapping & Hotkeys – Play your way with fully customizable controls, plus a handy hotkey to quickly place your last selected item again!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/aa01818d8949414b33f2eb3bd7914b665cba7f50.png[/img]

🧸 Dragon Toys – Your dragons now have adorable toys to play with! Watch them interact, have fun, and bring even more life to your sanctuary. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/757e1ad60f81415a3143ba2cdc05f24fc2749994.png[/img]

📏 Improved Grid & Rotation Snapping – Building and decorating are smoother than ever with better grid alignment and precise rotation snapping. Build placement hitboxes have been improved and changed to allow more freedom in where you build!


🔧 Game Customization Settings – Tailor your experience with new options to tweak gameplay to your liking. Only a few options are exposed with this update, and they will mostly help streamers make their game play more exciting by increasing the pace. There are a lot more options coming in future updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/9387bffbf4189d88e388768f70de48e306f02067.png[/img]

🚀 Performance Optimizations – A smoother, more polished experience with improved game performance. A lot of the AI has been rewritten, including path finding which is now a lot more performant.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/805a2735a92a5df5b7a2154ba42247364de48ff4.png[/img]


…and more surprises to discover!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/0f54b8fa0b62d774f72f01fb889dcef6c594765d.png[/img]

Your sanctuary is growing, and so is Dragon Sprouts! Let us know what you think, and stay tuned for even more exciting updates. 🐲💚

notes.title: Pre-Beta Overhaul Update
notes.notes:
Beta is coming fast! This was a massive overhaul to get ready for it, and now beta is just around the corner.

The look and feel of the game has received a whole lot of love this last week:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/4727fb4b2595afdbb6e9bdcf90a42d70c1058bf2.png[/img]

Gremlins now behave a lot more naturally. Instead of bunching up they now move around more independently and feel a lot more like a lot of little creatures rather than one big group.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/e01372c5b7c1cd156542bae4710d7f1189b639ff.png[/img] 

A ton more items to use to customize your dragon's home. There are now over 50 buildable items in the game, and I have plans to keep adding more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/8b1f4b96684f0eb4760041da935d2d6f8c1e87a5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/a912b2dce14e047f343cb8772d952e3effc1deee.png[/img]

I've added benchmarking and complete performance related user options:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512990/0ede8d363da41e4767e06b654a6158fadbf39e18.png[/img]

On top of everything else there's a very long list of tiny tweaks and fixes. I'm really excited to see this game get in the hands of beta testers here soon and I can't wait to be able to add all the fixes, tweaks, and adjustments they recommend.
